battle.name: 韶州之戰
battle.brief: 開寶三年（970）十二月，宋軍主帥潘美長驅至韶州，南漢都統李承渥以十餘萬眾屯蓬華峰下，教象為陣，每象載十數人以壯軍威。潘美不與象陣硬撼，盡索軍中勁弩齊射，象受驚奔踶反踩本陣，宋軍乘勢大敗南漢。此役倚重者正是弩機：亞述長弓的複合角弓在中原早成陳跡，弩才是宋代壓制巨獸的實際手段。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰雙方是北宋與南漢。北宋方面，開寶三年（970）九月，宋太祖趙匡胤在湖南正面部署行營：以潭州防禦使潘美為賀州道行營兵馬都部署，朗州團練使尹崇珂副之，道州刺史王繼勳為行營馬軍都監，並遣使發諸州兵赴賀州城下集結；行營另設隨軍轉運使王明，主管糧秣輜重。編制上，北宋遠征軍以中央禁軍為骨幹，混編湖南各州廂軍與團練民兵，步兵居多而騎兵居少，攻城所需器械與填壕用的畚鍬均隨軍征發。南漢方面，都城廣州番禺由皇帝劉鋹坐鎮，實權卻集中於少數宦官與將領：都統李承渥掌韶州方向兵權，馬步軍都統潘崇徹領眾三萬屯賀江，招討使盧收守連州、敗退清遠，大將植廷曉與後來接手的郭崇岳分屯要隘。南漢立國四十七年，宿將多以讒言見殺，宗室剪滅殆盡，能握兵者只剩宦官數輩，此役之前其統帥系統已近乎崩解。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Northern Song and Southern Han. On the Song side, in the ninth month of the third year of Kaibao (970), Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin set up a field headquarters in the Hunan theatre: Pan Mei, formerly commander of Tanzhou, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Hedzhou Circuit Field Army, Yin Chongke of Langzhou was made his deputy, and Wang Jixun, governor of Daozhou, was put in charge of the cavalry of the field army; envoys were additionally sent to summon the troops of the various prefectures to assemble beneath Hedzhou. The headquarters also carried a Supervisor of Transport, Wang Ming, in charge of grain and baggage. In composition, the Song expeditionary force was built around the central imperial guards, mixed with militia and provincial auxiliary troops from Hunan; infantry predominated while cavalry was scarce, and the siege equipment and the wicker baskets and spades used to fill the ditches travelled with the army. On the Southern Han side, the capital at Panyu in Guangzhou was held by the emperor Liu Chang, yet real power lay with a handful of eunuchs and commanders: the Commander-in-Chief Li Chengwo held the military authority in the Shaozhou direction, the Commander of Horse and Foot Pan Chongche led thirty thousand men and held them at the He River, the Commissioner for Pacification Lu Shou defended Lianzhou and fell back to Qingyuan, and the general Zhi Tingxiao, together with Guo Chonyue who took over later, garrisoned the key passes. Southern Han had existed for forty-seven years; its veteran generals had mostly been killed on slander, the royal clan had been all but exterminated, and only a few eunuchs still held troops. Before this battle its command system was therefore close to collapse.
people: 宋方主腦是趙匡胤。他不急於直取廣州，先在湖南道設行營、由潘美統軍，判斷是嶺南北路一旦打通，番禺的門戶自開。南漢主劉鋹是關鍵人物，也是此戰最大的失誤來源：他曾對左右說，昭、桂、連、賀本屬湖南，如今北師取之足矣，其不復南也；北兵已取連州、盧收退保清遠，他仍不作整體部署。潘美臨陣表現最關鍵，他既敢長驅深入，又能在象陣面前改變戰法，以遠射專射駕象者與象身，令南漢自置的鋒刃反噬本軍。尹崇珂為副將、王繼勳掌行營馬軍，賀州一役的攻城則靠轉運使王明以百餘輜重卒與數千丁夫畚鍬並作，堙壕直抵城門。南漢方面，都統李承渥在蓬華峰下練象為陣，兵敗僅以身免；潘崇徹久罷兵柄、心懷怏怏，領三萬屯賀江卻擁兵自保，翌年乃降；被起用掌兵的郭崇岳則被史家評為無謀勇，惟日禱於鬼神而已。城破之後，韶州刺史辛延渥與諫議大夫鄒文遠為宋軍所擒。
peopleEn: The directing mind on the Song side was Zhao Kuangyin. He did not rush straight at Guangzhou; he first set up a field army in the Dao circuit and put it under Pan Mei, reasoning that once the northern road through the mountains was opened the gateway to Panyu would lie open by itself. Liu Chang, the Southern Han ruler, was the pivotal figure and the source of the largest mistakes: he told his attendants that Zhao, Gui, Lian and He had belonged to Hunan in the first place, and that once the northern army had taken them it would be satisfied and would not push further south; even after the Northern army had taken Lianzhou and Lu Shou had fallen back to Qingyuan he still made no overall deployment. Pan Mei performed best on the field. He dared to drive deep, and when the elephant phalanx came into view he changed the method of battle, firing at long range with the whole army's heavy crossbows aimed at the animals and their handlers, so that the Southern Han's own weapon turned against its own line. Yin Chongke was deputy, Wang Jixun commanded the cavalry, and the reduction of Hedzhou was the work of the transport supervisor Wang Ming, who led a hundred baggage guards and several thousand labouring men with baskets and spades, filling the ditch and bringing the works level with the city gate. On the Southern Han side the commander-in-chief Li Chengwo had drilled an elephant formation on the slope of Penghua Peak and escaped with his life alone when the army broke; Pan Chongche, long deprived of command and nursing a grievance, held thirty thousand at the He River yet kept them to himself, and surrendered only the following year; the new commander Guo Chonyue, whom the historians describe as having neither resource nor courage and who spent his days only praying to ghosts and spirits, was recommended by the palace woman Liang Luanzhen. After the city fell the Southern Han governor of Shaozhou, Xin Yanwo, and the remonstrance official Zou Wenyuan were taken prisoner.
kits: 本卡所列的亞述長弓，是前七世紀兩河流域的複合角弓：亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。它不會出現在九百多年後的嶺南戰場，但它代表的是『弓』這一兵種的技術譜系，角、筋、木三層膠合的複合弓與中原漢唐以來的蹶張弓、步弓同出一源，宋軍步卒所攜的弓在形制上仍是這條譜系的末端。真正決定韶州之戰勝負的投射兵器是弩：潘美『盡索軍中勁弩射之』，把全軍可用之弩集中一次齊射，專取象身與駕象之人，象受驚奔踶，乘坐者盡墜，反踩本軍陣列。換言之，亞述式的『弓兵開路』在宋代被『勁弩破陣』所取代。南漢一方最醒目的裝備是戰象，每頭象上載十數人，各執兵杖，置於陣前以壯軍威，這是南疆特有而中原自晚唐以來已罕見的軍備。宋軍除弩弓之外，尚備刀、槍、皮甲與札甲，並攜攻城器械與畚鍬；糧秣由隨軍轉運使王明沿潭、衡、邵、永、郴一線後轉，粵北山嶺運糧艱難，故有賀州之役中丁夫數千填壕的工程場面；北江水路則可供舟船與輸卒通行。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on this card is the composite bow of the seventh-century-BCE Mesopotamian world: the Assyrians conquered the two rivers with the combination of bow and iron, their archers shooting from the chariot while the charioteers rode in the archers' path. It would not appear on a Lingnan battlefield more than nine centuries later, yet it stands for the technological lineage of the bow as a branch of troops, for a composite bow of horn, sinew and wood laminated together shares its ancestry with the strongman's bow and the ordinary war bow of the Chinese middle ages down to the Song, and the bows carried by Song infantry remained the far end of that same lineage. The missile weapon that actually decided the battle of Shaozhou was the crossbow: Pan Mei gathered every heavy crossbow in the army into a single volley, aimed at the bodies of the elephants and at their handlers, and the animals bolted and trampled, throwing down every rider and crushing their own formation. In other words, the Assyrian formula of archers opening the way was replaced in the Song by the heavy crossbow breaking the line. The most striking equipment on the Southern Han side was the war elephant, with more than ten men riding on each animal, every one of them holding a weapon staff, the column placed in front to bolster the morale of the host; this was a southern armament that the Chinese proper had seldom seen since the late Tang. Beside crossbows and bows the Song army carried swords, spears, leather and lamellar armour, and brought siege machines, baskets and spades with it. Grain travelled under the transport supervisor Wang Ming along the line of Tanzhou, Hengzhou, Shaozhou, Yongzhou and Chenzhou, for carrying supplies through the mountains of northern Guangdong was hard, which is why the siege of Hedzhou shows several thousand labourers filling a ditch; the waterways of the Bei River could carry boats and transport troops.
tactics: 韶州之戰的戰術核心是不硬碰象陣。南漢李承渥列象於前線，圖以巨獸的體量與威勢先破宋軍鋒頭；潘美不與之對撞，而是自遠處集中全軍勁弩一次齊射，箭矢專趨象身與駕者，象群受痛受驚，掉頭奔踶，衝入本軍行列反施其虐，宋軍步騎隨即全線壓上，卒賴此一擊而全勝。就整條南征線看，宋軍的戰術特徵是『工程先於正面』：賀州攻城時，轉運使王明不待援軍至，便率護送輜重卒百餘人、丁夫數千，畚鍬並作，一夜堙平壕溝、逼近城門，迫使守軍開門；韶州則是破陣在前、取城在後，兵勢一挫即乘勝入城。行營體制上，兵馬都部署總節制，馬軍都監掌騎兵，轉運使管糧道，任用上互不掣肘。南漢則因將領互疑，多事時守時潰，實戰中不斷出現『擁兵自保』『退保清遠』一類消極動作，縱有十餘萬眾亦無合戰之陣。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the battle of Shaozhou was to avoid colliding head-on with the elephant phalanx. Li Chengwo of Southern Han put the elephants in the front rank, hoping that the bulk and the terror of the beasts would first break the Song spearhead; Pan Mei did not charge them but concentrated every heavy crossbow of the army into one long-range volley, the bolts going for the animals and the mahouts, and the elephants, maddened and hurt, wheeled and bolted into the Southern Han ranks, trampling their own men. The Song foot and horse then pressed home along the whole line, and a single blow brought total victory. Along the whole southern road the Song method can be summarised as engineering before the frontal assault: at Hedzhou the transport supervisor Wang Ming did not wait for reinforcements but led a hundred baggage guards and several thousand labourers, baskets and spades working together, filled the ditch overnight and brought the works level with the gate so that the garrison was obliged to open the city. At Shaozhou the pattern was reversed: the line was broken first and the city was taken afterwards, the attack following at once on the momentum of the success. In organisation the Commander-in-Chief of Horse and Foot held the overall command, the Supervisor of the Horse led the cavalry, and the transport officer ran the supply line, none encroaching on the others. Southern Han, by contrast, was undermined by mutual suspicion among its commanders, mixing half-hearted defence with sudden collapse; repeatedly there was no battle line at all but the slogans of holding the men in place or falling back to Qingyuan, and even a host of more than a hundred thousand men produced nothing that could be fought as one.
data: 時序可考：開寶三年（970）九月，趙匡胤發兵，命諸州兵赴賀州城下；是月師克連州，南漢招討使盧收率眾退保清遠；十二月，潘美長驅至韶州，與李承渥遇於蓬華峰下；開寶四年（971），潘美克英、雄二州，潘崇徹來降，廣州之戰繼之，二月劉鋹出降，南漢亡。兵員方面，南漢韶州軍記載為十餘萬，潘崇徹另領眾三萬屯賀江，馬逕之役南漢列眾六萬；宋軍總數史無明文，僅知其為禁軍為主、混編諸州團練的遠征軍。損失方面，賀州前哨南漢主將伍彥柔所部死者十七八，其本人被擒斬、梟首示城而城中猶固守；韶州之役宋軍斬獲數不載於史，僅記擒南漢韶州刺史辛延渥及諫議大夫鄒文遠。空間上，韶州扼北江上游，為自賀、昭、桂、連一線南下番禺的咽喉；南漢象陣每象載十數人，十數頭象構成一列前鋒，即等於數百人同時投入第一線；宋軍齊射所用之弩，數目史無明載，只記『盡索軍中勁弩』。
dataEn: The sequence can be dated. In the ninth month of the third year of Kaibao (970) Zhao Kuangyin sent out his troops and ordered the soldiers of the prefectures to assemble beneath Hedzhou; in that same month the army took Lianzhou and the Southern Han commissioner for pacification Lu Shou drew his men back to Qingyuan. In the twelfth month Pan Mei drove ahead to Shaozhou and came into contact with Li Chengwo below Penghua Peak. In the fourth year of Kaibao (971) Pan Mei took Yizhou and Xiongzhou, Pan Chongche came in to surrender, the battle for Guangzhou followed, and in the second month Liu Chang came out and surrendered, ending Southern Han. On numbers: the Southern Han force at Shaozhou is recorded as more than a hundred thousand men, Pan Chongche held a further thirty thousand at the He River, and at Majing the Southern Han drew up sixty thousand. The total of the Song army is nowhere stated plainly; it is known only to have been chiefly imperial guards combined with the trained militia of the prefectures. On losses, at Hedzhou the Southern Han commander Wu Yanrou's men suffered about seven or eight men in ten, and he himself was taken and beheaded with his head displayed before the city, which nevertheless held out. No figures are preserved for the Song losses at Shaozhou, where only the capture of the Southern Han governor Xin Yanwo and the remonstrance official Zou Wenyuan is recorded. In space, Shaozhou commands the upper Bei River and is the throat of the road running south from He, Zhao, Gui and Lian to Panyu; with more than ten men on each animal, a column of a dozen elephants put several hundred men into the first line at once; and the number of crossbows in the Song volley is nowhere given, only the phrase that every heavy crossbow in the army was gathered up.
cause: 此役的起因，是北宋『先南後北』的統一方略推到最後一步。開寶初年宋已滅後蜀，又平南唐，南方只剩嶺南一國南漢；南漢憑五嶺天險、倚海路與番禺財賦，歷來對中原朝廷持敵視態度，宋使往來中詔令與貢禮互有爭執，最終以出兵相迫。趙匡胤的戰略很清楚：北軍不便於嶺南作戰，與其坐待南漢先動，不如先取湖南四州，扼住北江通道，把番禺從北面打開。因此自開寶三年九月起，他以賀州道設行營，次第取富州、賀州、連州、昭州、桂州，把後勤與兵源都擺在身後的湖南，而主力不急著越嶺深入。內政則是南漢更深的病根：劉鋹崇飾宮殿、聚斂財貨、誅戮宗室與宿將，掌兵的只剩宦官數輩，李承渥、潘崇徹、植廷曉各懷異心，遇宋軍北來便各自打算，於是十餘萬大軍在韶州城下崩潰。
causeEn: The cause of this campaign was the last step of the Song strategy of pacifying the south before the north. In the early years of Kaibao the Song had already destroyed Later Shu and then put down Southern Tang, leaving only one southern state, Southern Han, in Lingnan. Southern Han, holding behind the barrier of the Five Ridges and relying on the sea route and the wealth of Panyu, had always regarded the central court with hostility, and the envoys exchanged between the two states quarrelled over edicts and tribute until the quarrel was settled by troops. Zhao Kuangyin's reasoning was plain: the northern army was awkward in Lingnan, and rather than wait for Southern Han to strike first it was better to seize the four prefectures of Hunan, grip the corridor of the Bei River and open Panyu from the north. Hence from the ninth month of the third year of Kaibao he established a field headquarters in the Hedzhou circuit and took Fuzhou, Hedzhou, Lianzhou, Zhaozhou and Guizhou in turn, keeping the supplies and the recruiting ground behind him in Hunan while the main force did not hurry to cross the mountains. The deeper fault lay in Southern Han's domestic order: Liu Chang indulged in palaces, piled up treasure, killed the royal clan and the veteran generals, and left only a few eunuchs in command; Li Chengwo, Pan Chongche and Zhi Tingxiao each had their own calculation, and when the Song army came north each of them thought only of himself, so that an army of more than a hundred thousand broke up below Shaozhou.
impact: 韶州之戰的結果，是南漢最後一批精銳部隊在嶺北被一次殲滅，廣州自此無險可守。開寶四年，潘美克英州、雄州，南漢馬步軍都統潘崇徹率眾來降；南漢主劉鋹在無兵可用之際，聽從宮媼梁鸞真之薦，起用養子郭崇岳為招討使，與大將植廷曉率眾六萬屯馬逕、列柵拒宋，然而郭崇岳為人無謀勇，惟日禱於鬼神而已，不久即告敗，廣州城破，劉鋹奉表降宋，南漢至此終結。宋於廣州置鎮，後分為廣南東、西二路，嶺南正式納入中原王朝版圖，成為對南海貿易的門戶，舶來象牙、犀角與香料的市易因此更盛。更深一層的影響在兵制與技術：此役是中國兵史中少數以弩機集群齊射破解巨獸戰陣的明確記載，說明宋人對南方巨象的戰法已由唐末以來的冷落轉為專門準備，弩手、弩造工與配箭制度在南方戰線上的地位隨之上昇；同時它也暴露了南漢以宦官領軍、以宗室空耗的體制弱點，並為後來平湖南、平江南諸役一再重複的『取水道、斷糧道、以工程越壕』的攻城套路提供了樣板。
impactEn: The effect of the battle of Shaozhou was that the last trained formations of Southern Han were annihilated in one stroke north of the mountains, and Guangzhou was left with no natural defence. In the fourth year of Kaibao Pan Mei took Yizhou and Xiongzhou, and the Southern Han commander of horse and foot, Pan Chongche, came in with his men. With no troops left to use, the Southern Han ruler Liu Chang followed the recommendation of the palace woman Liang Luanzhen and appointed his adopted son Guo Chonyue as commissioner for pacification, who with the general Zhi Tingxiao led sixty thousand men to Majing and set up a stockade of fences to resist the Song. But Guo Chonyue was a man of neither resource nor courage who spent his days only praying to ghosts and spirits, and he was defeated soon after; the walls of Guangzhou fell, Liu Chang sent in his surrender, and Southern Han came to an end. The Song established a garrison at Guangzhou, later divided into the eastern and western circuits of Guangnan, and Lingnan was formally drawn into the empire of the central plains, becoming the gateway to the trade of the South Sea, in which ivory, rhinoceros horn and aromatics from abroad grew busier still. The deeper effect lay in arms and technique: this is one of the few clear records in Chinese military history of a massed volley of crossbows breaking a war-elephant formation, showing that the Song approach to the great beasts of the south had moved from the neglect of the late Tang to deliberate preparation, with the crossbowman, the crossbow smith and the arrow supply system all rising in standing on the southern front. At the same time it exposed the weakness of the Southern Han system, which entrusted command to eunuchs while squandering the royal clan, and it provided a model for the siege methods of the later campaigns against Hunan and Jiangnan, with the water route taken, the supply line cut, and the ditch crossed by engineering works.
result: 直接結果：開寶三年十二月，潘美所部與李承渥十餘萬眾在韶州城外蓬華峰下接戰。潘美不與象陣硬撼，盡索軍中勁弩一次齊射，象受驚奔踶，乘坐者盡墜，反踩南漢本軍，軍遂大敗，李承渥僅以身免；宋軍乘勝進取韶州，擒南漢韶州刺史辛延渥及諫議大夫鄒文遠，奪取韶州城。戰果意義：南漢僅餘的抵抗力量被一役蕩平，此後其各地守軍再無能力與宋軍抗衡。連鎖反應：開寶四年，潘美克英、雄二州，潘崇徹降；郭崇岳與植廷曉率眾六萬屯馬逕列柵拒宋，旋告敗潰；同年二月，劉鋹出降，廣州入宋，南漢亡。此役於宋人記載中著墨不多，細節主要見於《續資治通鑑·宋紀六》開寶三年、四年兩卷，並可與《宋史》卷四百八十一《南漢劉氏》互證；其中兵力數字多有互相矛盾之處，宜以諸說並存看待。
resultEn: The immediate result: in the twelfth month of the third year of Kaibao the troops of Pan Mei came into contact with the more than a hundred thousand men of Li Chengwo below Penghua Peak outside Shaozhou. Pan Mei would not collide head-on with the elephant phalanx but gathered every heavy crossbow of the army into a single volley; the elephants were maddened and bolted, every rider was thrown down, they trampled the Southern Han ranks, the army was utterly beaten and Li Chengwo escaped with his life alone. The Song army pressed on and took Shaozhou, capturing the Southern Han governor of the prefecture, Xin Yanwo, and the remonstrance official Zou Wenyuan. In significance: the last of the resistance of Southern Han was swept away in a single battle, and after it the garrisons of that kingdom could no longer hold off the Song army for any length of time. The chain reaction: in the fourth year of Kaibao Pan Mei took Yizhou and Xiongzhou and Pan Chongche surrendered; Guo Chonyue and Zhi Tingxiao with sixty thousand men stockaded Majing against the Song and were soon beaten; in the second month of the same year Liu Chang came out and surrendered, Guangzhou passed to the Song, and Southern Han was no more. Southern Han writers gave the battle little space; the details come chiefly from the third and fourth years of Kaibao in the sixth section of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian, which can be cross-checked against the Southern Han Liu clan in volume 481 of the Song Shi. The figures for the opposing forces contradict one another in several places, and they are best taken as a matter of competing accounts.
